notes.title: FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hello, thank you all for the support, I consider the current state of the game as ready to be marked as full release!

Please enjoy!

notes.title: QUALITY UPDATE
notes.notes:
Improved all fights by reducing total enemies amount but increasing their spawn rate
 Made dead enemies and body parts to easier stay on the ground
 Improved color correction, contrast and brightness in game
 Fine-tuned difficulties presets
 Improved blood on screen health indicator
 Impoved skies
 Downscaled UI - to make screen more clear
 Added saving indicator
 Removed subtitles that was shown up over enemies heads
 Improved crosshair
 Fixed player was able to die in tutorial level
 Other small fixes&improvements

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.notes:
Fixed: videos in tutorials ( in UI and in Tutorial level ) didn't played for some people
 Fixed: ammo in the Marichka Chase sequence wasn't lit
 Remove doors when fight in the Toilet Exit Room begins, they removed when player doesn't look at them - because player could have stumble upon them when running backwards
 Made last wave in Toilet Exit Room easier
 Added white Z Blockers in the Toilet Exit Room doorways - some people were trying to go through them just to find invisible wall
 Reworked mouse invert options, as it was requested
 Increased PUSH radius, it's now wider horizontally and vertically. It's also affecting objects a little behind player too

notes.title: Big update improving player experience
notes.notes:
Tutorials
Added short tutorial for PUSH mechanic - players will only need to play it once. 
But it will be also available via main menu and pause menu

This mechanic is essential, 
It's the reason why player doesn't have enough ammo to kill all enemies.
Please use the PUSH instead of grab&throw all the time))

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/b90a2d3860482945676d51c5639fd7e97c859d90.gif

Improved Occupier's Dream tutorial - added video

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/2232701c8bc51bb03450ab27de86efa9167ad5a1.gif

Improved Sticky Mine Launcher tutorial - less text and added video

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/5276d3dfbcadb10ec18bae23697f4b609a430ee3.gif

User Interface

 Show weapons list in UI so player can see all available weapons and their ammo.
 Display only the amount of ammo in UI ( removed max possible ammo amount ) - some players was confused and seeking for reload button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/75242c91da466b67d51e9eb1335d3997c07fe5c3.png

 Improved visibility of the PUSH availability indicator - now it's will remain transparent during all reload cycle. So it's easier to see if it's reloaded using only peripheral vision.
Also added small transparent indicator in the center of crosshair,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/f647e3cf72a10b879c4f5799db9af431e5c8117b.gif

 Made ammo more visible - all of it is now lit

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/5cb329f2d670b1cd90aac84acb8553a62ee3f90c.png


Gallery

 Added lights to make pictures lit, also added the text "look" on them - many players was confused and didn't know what to do there.
 Tuned some sounds/music volume a bit.
 Made some enemies faster.
 Fixed: music started over when player goes back triggering checkpoint save again.


Other

 Prevent player from going out of room too soon in the upper toilet horror sequence.
 Removed push and grab/throw paused tutorials from the start of the game.
 Fixed: subtitles above rashists adoring toilet were not translated.
 Changed Revolver pick up location so it's more notable - many players didn't know where it came from)
 Make "Continue" button more notable in paused tutorials.
 Added Inverted mouse option as it was requested
 Added white ZBlockers - they will be displayed in places where they can't be removed by player actions - the red ones are removable by player action.
 Fixed player was able to simply outrun first fights to Arena1 without any fights
 Fixed: interactable hit might not cause damage to enemy due to throttle of hits processing
 Fixed: red/blue chair was jumping up too much by the PUSH
 Increased damage caused by interactables - because previous fixes to overly rotating interactables by the PUSH reduced damage
 Fixed: heavy interactables/enemies was to weakly pushed by blast wave
 Fixed missing putin icon in the "Corner of traditional values" of last cutscene


Looks like no one has found a secret weapon... which is not really that secret - just forgot to disable it) 
Feel like you will be disappointed after searching every corner for it))

notes.title: Release fixes&improvements compared to build provided to IndieCup
notes.notes:
Fixed most of the issues related to enemies stuck in floor/wall blocking further progression.
 Fixed spawning redundant 1-2 enemies in toilet exit room after the door has been lit green and became openable
 Fixed toilet not picking up if player already in range when ToiletCarrier dies
 Added a bit more ammo at the game start
 Fixed possibility of player having 0 ammo at the start of the "Russian World Gallery" 
 Changed interactables pushing - now they fly and rotate less
